old_text: When no hostname is passed HTTPie should not error out and should attempt a reasonable default connection.
new_text: When no hostname is passed HTTPie must default the request to localhost so that commands like http :8080 work correctly.

old_text: Near-duplicate response content is treated as duplicate when the content is broadly similar and the IP is the same.
new_text: Near-duplicate response content is treated as duplicate when the SimHash distance is less than or equal to 3 and the IP is the same.
